118267.name: Agudas Chassidei Chabad
118267.note: Wikipedia: 'In 1940, after arriving in the United States, Schneersohn became president, effectively making the American branch the worldwide organization base'; Agudas Chasidei Chabad bought 770 Eastern Parkway in 1940 (Wikipedia, 770 Eastern Parkway). Founded by the Rebbe Rayatz in 1923; 'The American branch existed at least as far back as 1927' (elsewhere in New York, before Crown Heights). (Crown Heights, owner Nov 10: do the 12 real mosdos; the year it began in America, not in Europe or Eretz Yisroel.)

117986.name: Library of Agudas Chassidei Chabad
117986.note: Wikipedia's infobox: established 1940 (with the Rebbe Rayatz's move to 770); a visitor guide says 1941. Its reading room opened in 1992 and its exhibition hall in 1994. Medium: one encyclopedia year, one other source differs. (Crown Heights, owner Nov 10: do the 12 real mosdos; the year it began in America, not in Europe or Eretz Yisroel.)

117670.name: Merkos L'inyonei Chinuch

Wikipedia's infobox says 1943. (Crown Heights, owner Nov 10: do the 12 real mosdos; the year it began in America, not in Europe or Eretz Yisroel.)
